sentences.en: Countervailing opinions have sadly prevented me from instituting martial law.
sentences.zh: 1. 相反的意见悲哀地阻止了我实施军事法律。

sentences.en: The little mermaid sighed and looked sadly at her fish tail.
sentences.zh: 2. 小美人鱼叹了口气，悲伤地看着她的鱼尾。

sentences.en: Sadly, he isn't as skilled as he is enthusiastic.
sentences.zh: 3. 不幸的是，他虽然热情高涨但技术并不娴熟。
